questions.e: Nvidia's board voted unanimously to reinstate Jensen Huang as president, CEO and board director, effective immediately, 11 days after he resigned. Interim CEO Colette Kress returned to her CFO role.
questions.q: What news from Nvidia's board sparked Monday's huge rally in chip and AI stocks?

questions.e: Nvidia shares jumped about 31% to around $165 after Huang's reinstatement. Yahoo Finance called it the stock's best day since May 2003.
